planning_proxy.meaning: Euclidean distance to 50m cell centers and assumed site budget under nearest-site association. NOT RF coverage/capacity. Only assumed outdoor-network share is constrained; pending indoor demand NOT served or validated.
planning_proxy.constraint_scope: outdoor-network assumed traffic only, not full city demand

low.note: Fixed-layout demand sensitivity, not a separate optimized deployment or RF validation.

medium.note: Fixed-layout demand sensitivity, not a separate optimized deployment or RF validation.

high.note: Fixed-layout demand sensitivity, not a separate optimized deployment or RF validation.

all_building_traffic_to_outdoor.note: Same layout with 100% building traffic assigned to outdoor BS; no indoor offload assumed; not a separate optimized plan.

limitations: All UE/population/traffic values are synthetic expectations, not measured counts; land uses are assigned roles.
500m is a soft initialization scale, not mandatory spacing or a standard requirement.
No UE/RX positions, trajectories, scheduling, power, antenna pattern, SINR, throughput or new RT computed.
600Mbps/site is an assumed planning budget, NOT a predicted radio capacity.
Euclidean nearest-site association ignores blockage/indoor penetration/interference; indoor provision remains unresolved.
25m poles need not be above nearby roofs; physical permissions/power/backhaul unvalidated.
No external neighbor sites or boundary interference; high demand may exceed the fixed-layout budget.

assumptions.status: Synthetic planning assumptions, not measured population or verified building functions
assumptions.service_split_note: 35% of building traffic assigned to outdoor BS planning as an explicit scenario assumption; remaining 65% requires a separate indoor/WiFi solution and is NOT claimed served. All park/road/open demand assigned to outdoor network.
assumptions.population_method: Each building footprint * max(1,floor(height/3.3)) * 0.70; split residential/employment floor shares; disjoint floor areas, then time presence factors. Visitors represented only by outdoor area densities, not a second indoor population.

demand_model.spatial_semantics: Cell centers are demand aggregation/nearest-site planning probes, may lie indoors; NOT physical RX positions or simultaneous scheduled UEs.
